title: Plasma Globe in Sunset Room
description: A large plasma globe sits on a wooden desk, its central electrode glowing pink with branching neon tendrils of pink, blue, yellow and green electricity arcing toward the glass. Through the transparent sphere, a miniature painted landscape of green hills, a winding dirt road and fence is visible, perfectly aligned with the real rural sunset landscape seen through the large window behind it.
prompt: A large vintage plasma globe resting on a wooden desk in a wood-paneled mid-century room. Inside the glowing glass sphere is a detailed miniature landscape of rolling green hills and a winding dirt road that perfectly matches the real landscape visible through the window behind it. Bright pink, blue, yellow and green plasma tendrils arc from the central electrode. A retro orange sofa, starburst clock, ashtray and books are visible. Warm sunset light bathes the scene with purple and orange sky outside, surreal and dreamlike atmosphere.
